name: Aguadilla (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Horizontal bicolour of blue and gold, the predominant colours of the arms, charged at the centre with the municipal coat of arms within laurels.
history: Aguadilla, founded in 1775 by Luis de Córdova, is a city and municipality located in the northwestern tip of Puerto Rico, bordered by the Atlantic Ocean to the north and west, north of Aguada, and Moca and west of Isabela. The flag was adopted in 1972 (designed in 1972 on the recommendation of the Institute of Puerto Rican Culture for the 200th anniversary of the city's foundation, according to Flags of the World).
